evals.name: single-feature
evals.prompt: Run spec on evals/files/single/ for feature LCK-1.
evals.expected_output: Task plan and validation suite for LCK-1, produced by running the 3-stage pipeline directly (no subagent).
assertions: LCK-1-tasks.md exists at evals/files/single/LCK/LCK-1/LCK-1-tasks.md
LCK-1-tasks.md contains a summary table with at least 3 tasks
LCK-1-tasks.md contains detailed task headings with Steps, Implementation requirements, and Verification scenarios sections
LCK-1-tasks.md task descriptions reference link extraction concepts from the feature spec (inline links, reference links, location tracking)
LCK-1-validations.md exists at evals/files/single/LCK/LCK-1/LCK-1-validations.md
LCK-1-validations.md contains scenario IDs matching the LCK-1-VS{N} pattern
LCK-1-validations.md contains at least one scenario tagged (A) and covers all exit criteria from the feature spec
LCK-1-validations.md contains the Automation Legend section with (A) and (H) definitions
The agent printed stage progress messages for all 3 stages
The agent printed a completion summary listing both artifact file paths
The completion summary reports no failures

evals.name: multiple-features
evals.prompt: Run spec on evals/files/multi/ for features COR-1, COR-2, COR-3.
evals.expected_output: Task plans and validation suites for all 3 features, produced via subagents in parallel batches.
assertions: COR-1-tasks.md exists at evals/files/multi/COR/COR-1/COR-1-tasks.md and is non-empty
COR-2-tasks.md exists at evals/files/multi/COR/COR-2/COR-2-tasks.md and is non-empty
COR-3-tasks.md exists at evals/files/multi/COR/COR-3/COR-3-tasks.md and is non-empty
COR-1-validations.md exists at evals/files/multi/COR/COR-1/COR-1-validations.md and is non-empty
COR-2-validations.md exists at evals/files/multi/COR/COR-2/COR-2-validations.md and is non-empty
COR-3-validations.md exists at evals/files/multi/COR/COR-3/COR-3-validations.md and is non-empty
Each tasks file contains a summary table with task rows
Each tasks file contains detailed task headings with Steps and Verification scenarios sections
Each validations file contains scenario IDs matching the {FC}-VS{N} pattern for its feature code
The agent used subagents (not direct execution) for the 3-feature batch
The agent printed a completion summary listing all 6 artifact file paths
The completion summary reports no failures

evals.name: missing-feature-spec
evals.prompt: Run spec on evals/files/missing/ for features API-1 and API-2.
evals.expected_output: API-1 succeeds (task plan + validation suite produced). API-2 is skipped because its feature spec does not exist. The completion summary reports API-2 as a failure.
assertions: API-1-tasks.md exists at evals/files/missing/API/API-1/API-1-tasks.md and is non-empty
API-1-validations.md exists at evals/files/missing/API/API-1/API-1-validations.md and is non-empty
No API-2-tasks.md or API-2-validations.md files were created
The agent reported that API-2 has no feature spec and was skipped
The completion summary lists API-2 as a failure or skipped feature
The completion summary lists API-1 artifacts as successfully produced
